rule: maximise wrong_removed subject to correct_lost <= 5% on ClearGrasp D435 val (rel5% tolerance, mask region, pooled pixels), over results/rgb_proposal_tune_val.csv
tie_break: ring 5 px with min_basin_depth_m 0.03 ties across min_basin_depth_rel 0.0 / 0.015 / 0.03; take 0.015, the v0.1 value
test_runs: real-test/d435 and real-test/d415, once per configuration; no change to the method afterwards
mask_network: ClearGrasp mask_segmentation/checkpoint_mask.pth (sha256 e8d36e4b...ff1863), 256x256 nearest resize, argmax; trained on synthetic images only
